# Actual PlasAnn web outputs

`pbr322.gbk` and `pkpqil.gbk` were downloaded unmodified from PlasAnn's web
service on 21 October 2026 after submission of FASTA sequences J01749.1 and
GU595196.1 respectively, using defaults without enhanced UniProt annotation.
The custom output names were `cellgen-pbr322-validation` and
`cellgen-pkpqil-validation`. The service version was not exposed.

See the [validation report](../../../analysis/plasann-validation/README.md)
for checksums, importer tests, omitted feature types and the KPC allele-label
discrepancy. These files test faithful conversion of upstream annotations.
